name: Presentation Coach
tagline: Rehearsal partner for a talk: outline, slides, notes, then a scored dry run
description: Takes a talk from idea to stage-ready: brainstorm the outline together, draft the slides and speaker notes, then run a rehearsal past it and get notes on the deck as well as your delivery. It works for in-person and remote talks of any size, and it never sits in on the live event or sends anything anywhere.
author: ladybarrelmaker
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
